entry.title: Walmart plans $400M Texas distribution center
entry.summary: The retailer expects to break ground on the more than 744,000-square-foot facility in Cibolo this February.

entry.title: UPS aims to double RFID-labeled volume from customer locations
entry.summary: The carrier expects 6 million packages a day will benefit from the offering in 2027, increasing shipper visibility in the process, CEO Carol Tomé said.

entry.title: USDA to fund 8 fertilizer manufacturing projects totaling more than $1.3B
entry.summary: The agency said the projects will add production capacity to drive prices lower and reduce the nation’s reliance on nutrients from other countries.

entry.title: Context changes everything: what supplier contracts reveal about supply chain performance
entry.summary: Clarity across supplier contracts helps procurement teams uncover savings, risk and performance insights.

entry.title: Why more inventory won’t fix your supply chain’s fill rate
entry.summary: Record inventory but still missing fill rate targets? The problem isn't supply or forecasting; it's your supply chain decision layer. Here's how to fix it.

entry.title: Runnings unites forecasting, replenishment with AI
entry.summary: The farm, home and outdoor goods retailer is rolling out Relex Solutions’ artificial-intelligence platform across its store and distribution network in phases.

entry.title: Walmart commits $6B to up distribution center automation with Symbotic
entry.summary: The retailer will deploy Symbotic's technology at 25 regional facilities as it looks to improve speed and inventory replenishment.

entry.title: Norfolk Southern, Schneider National team to scale East Coast intermodal reach
entry.summary: The railroad’s potential merger with Union Pacific is “the icing on the cake” of the partnership, Schneider CEO Jim Filter said.

entry.title: Reshoring and foreign direct investment added 247K manufacturing jobs in 2025
entry.summary: The result “essentially matched” the previous year, per the Reshoring Initiative, which expects 25% growth in reshoring-related jobs in 2026.

entry.title: Manufacturing expands for 10th straight month, but Iran war weighs heavily
entry.summary: Increasingly negative comments from respondents also cite price vitality and trade wars in the latest Purchasing Managers’ Index from the Institute for Supply Management.
